name: arabic-ecommerce-platform
description: Arabic RTL e-commerce platform with separate Store, Admin, and Backend API

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:store" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && npx cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm run start:dev
scripts.dev:store: cd store && npx cross-env NODE_ENV= NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:3001/api npm run dev
scripts.dev:admin: cd admin && npx cross-env NODE_ENV= NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:3001/api npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:store && npm run build:admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:backend && npm run typecheck:store && npm run typecheck:admin
scripts.validate: npm run db:generate && cd backend && npx prisma validate
scripts.verify:static: npm run validate && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:backend && npm run build
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:store && npm run lint:admin
